description: Track what this add-on bundles: Grafana Alloy, the Home Assistant base image, and the GitHub Actions. Every bump is a PR; nothing automerges - the operator decides what runs inside Home Assistant.

customManagers.description: ALLOY_VERSION in the Dockerfile follows grafana/alloy releases
The add-on version IS the Alloy version, so config.yaml moves with the same release

packageRules.description: One PR per Alloy release, touching Dockerfile and config.yaml together
Base image tags look like trixie-2026.08.0: track the date part within the trixie line
Pin the builder actions to their release tags, not a floating branch
